title: OSRS Demolished the Duel Arena After 18 Years
hook: The Duel Arena opened in 2004, got capped at 10 million coins a stake in November 2021, and was torn down in game at the start of 2022. Did you ever win or lose a bank there?
script: Did you know Old School RuneScape tore down its most famous gambling pit after eighteen years? The Duel Arena opened in the desert in two thousand four, and it was a hit from day one. Players could stake their whole bank on a single fight. Over time it became a magnet for scammers and gold sellers. Staking clans worked as a front for real world trading, and Jagex banned commission staking back in twenty fourteen. Fake duel settings tricked players into losing everything. In October twenty twenty one, Jagex announced the arena would be phased out for good. As a stopgap, that November they capped every stake at ten million coins. They also added whip and boxing presets so the duel rules were harder to fake. Then at the start of twenty twenty two the Duel Arena was shut down and demolished in game. Its replacement, the PvP Arena, arrived later that year. There is no wager at all. You fight on a separate world with preset gear, and winning earns rank points and reward points instead of someone else's bank. An activity older than most of its players was gone in a few months. Did you ever win or lose big at the Duel Arena? Follow for more gaming history.
